controlSet.description: Classify whether an agent action creates advisory, routing, eligibility, denial, approval, enforcement, or commitment effects.
High-consequence or unverifiable public-agent actions MUST escalate to a human review path and MUST NOT finalize silently.
Affected parties MUST receive a contestable record before preliminary determinations become final operational effects.
Receipts MUST include a machine-readable redress route, remedy class, responsible office, and review time bound.
The decision record MUST trace the technical actor to the public accountable controller, legal or policy mandate, scope, authority registry, and policy version.

failureModes: Public agent acts as if identity is sufficient authority
Affected person cannot identify accountable public controller
Machine-generated preliminary decision becomes final without contestability
Redress route is absent, non-machine-readable, or not bound to a decision receipt
Authority is unverifiable but execution proceeds fail-open
decisionPolicy: Public-agent actions SHOULD fail closed or escalate when mandate, current authority state, scope, receipt, or redress evidence is absent. Consequential public effects MUST remain contestable.
